## GTA 6 Guide: Approaching the Car Theft for Raul

As anticipation continues to build for the release of *Grand Theft Auto VI*, details regarding specific missions and gameplay mechanics are beginning to surface. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet GameRant, one of the notable tasks players will encounter involves stealing a Schafter V12 vehicle for a character named Raul.

### Multiple Approaches to Vehicle Theft

What stands out in this specific mission is the variety of approaches available to the player. Traditionally, vehicle theft missions in the GTA series lean heavily toward high-action, loud gunfights, or high-speed chases. However, the report indicates that players can take multiple approaches when stealing the Schafter V12 for Raul.

Notably, this includes a non-lethal way to complete the objective. For players who prefer stealth, strategy, or minimizing collateral damage, having a non-lethal option adds a layer of tactical depth that enhances the roleplaying experience within the game's open-world environment.

### Evolving Gameplay Freedom

While specific details regarding the exact mechanics of the stealth systems or how the non-lethal takedowns are executed remain to be fully detailed, the inclusion of multiple approaches points to Rockstar Games' continued focus on player agency. Whether players choose a stealthy infiltration or a more direct route, the design philosophy seems tailored to accommodate diverse playstyles.

### Editor's Take

The revelation that players can tackle standard heist and theft objectives like Raul's car using non-lethal methods is a welcome sign of expanded gameplay freedom in GTA 6. It gives stealth-oriented players more viability and adds to the overall depth of the game's mission design.
